description: Engine completion tasks for 11 under-covered engines — specific mechanics, physics, shaders, and integration missing from existing scaffolds

sprints.focus: Tier 1 Engine Completion (Vimshottari, Tarot, Runes, Numerology)

tasks.title: Implement Vimshottari ring RevoluteJoint: constrain rotation to ring Y-axis only
tasks.deliverable: Add Rapier RevoluteJoint to each Vimshottari ring constraining rotation to the ring's local Y-axis. The joint anchor is the ring center. Rotation limits set to +-Infinity (free spin). Damping coefficient 0.3 for natural deceleration after release.
tasks.acceptance: Each ring rotates only around its Y-axis via RevoluteJoint; Joint anchor at ring geometric center; Damping coefficient 0.3 produces natural deceleration; Ring cannot translate or rotate on other axes

tasks.title: Build Vimshottari Antardasha micro-ring: appears when vessel proximity < 3 units
tasks.deliverable: When vessel distance to Vimshottari Clock < 3 units, animate micro-rings appearing between the Maha Dasha rings. Each micro-ring displays Antardasha sub-periods for the currently selected Maha Dasha. Scale from 0 to 1 over 600ms with ease-out. Disappear when vessel moves beyond 3 units.
tasks.acceptance: Micro-rings appear when vessel proximity < 3 units; Each micro-ring shows Antardasha sub-periods of selected Maha ring; Scale animation 0 to 1 over 600ms with ease-out; Micro-rings disappear smoothly when distance > 3 units

tasks.title: Implement Vimshottari 9-planet Dasha period date mapping with variable year lengths
tasks.deliverable: Extend the Vimshottari endpoint with precise date mapping for all 9 planetary periods: Sun(6yr), Moon(10yr), Mars(7yr), Rahu(18yr), Jupiter(16yr), Saturn(19yr), Mercury(17yr), Ketu(7yr), Venus(20yr). Calculate exact start/end dates for Maha, Antar, and Pratyantar levels based on Moon longitude at birth.
tasks.acceptance: All 9 planetary periods calculated with exact start/end dates; Variable year lengths correctly applied (Sun=6, Moon=10, Mars=7, etc.); Maha, Antar, Pratyantar levels all have precise dates; Calculation accuracy verified against standard Vedic ephemeris tables

tasks.title: Build Vimshottari hover expansion: ring segment reveals period dates as floating 3D text
tasks.deliverable: When user hovers a ring segment, it expands radially by 0.3 units over 200ms. Floating 3D text appears above the segment showing: planet name, period start date, period end date, and duration. Text uses the shared billboard system with 40ms/char typewriter reveal.
tasks.acceptance: Hovered ring segment expands radially 0.3 units over 200ms; Floating 3D text shows planet name, start date, end date, duration; Text uses billboard system with 40ms/char typewriter effect; Segment contracts and text fades on hover exit

tasks.title: Implement Vimshottari PIP sync: central axis pulse rate matches detected breath rate
tasks.deliverable: Connect the Vimshottari Clock central axis to PIP breath rate data. The central golden axis pulsates (emissive oscillation 0.4 to 0.9) at the user's detected breath rate. Fallback to 4-second cycle (15 BPM) when PIP unavailable. Smooth interpolation between rate changes.
tasks.acceptance: Central axis emissive oscillates between 0.4 and 0.9; Oscillation frequency matches PIP-detected breath rate; Fallback to 4-second cycle when PIP unavailable; Smooth interpolation on breath rate changes (no abrupt jumps)

tasks.title: Create Vimshottari Devanagari glyph etching shader on ring geometry
tasks.deliverable: Write a custom ShaderMaterial that etches Devanagari planet name glyphs onto each ring surface. Use SDF (Signed Distance Field) technique with a glyph atlas texture. Glyphs appear carved into the gold surface with dark recessed channels. Emissive fill in the channels at 0.2 intensity (Deep Ink color).
tasks.acceptance: Devanagari glyphs render on each ring surface via custom ShaderMaterial; SDF technique produces crisp glyphs at any viewing distance; Glyphs appear carved with dark recessed channels; Channel emissive fill at 0.2 intensity in Deep Ink color (#1A1A2E)

tasks.title: Build Vimshottari output: text particles orbiting selected ring with distance-fade shader
tasks.deliverable: When a Dasha period is selected, interpretation text breaks into individual word particles that orbit the selected ring at radius +0.5 units. Each word is a billboard sprite. Words orbit at slightly different speeds for organic feel. Custom fragment shader fades opacity from 1.0 at ring proximity to 0.0 at 8 units distance.
tasks.acceptance: Interpretation words orbit selected ring as billboard sprites; Orbit radius is ring radius + 0.5 units; Words orbit at varying speeds for organic distribution; Fragment shader fades opacity: 1.0 at ring to 0.0 at 8 units distance

tasks.title: Implement Tarot SparkJS Deep Ink veil: splat cloud opacity 0.3, turbulence 0.8
tasks.deliverable: Replace the basic veil with a full SparkJS gaussian splat cloud using Deep Ink color (#1A1A2E). Configure splat opacity to 0.3 base, turbulence parameter to 0.8 for ethereal movement. Splat count: 2000 particles in a shell around the card spiral. Splats drift with Perlin noise displacement.
tasks.acceptance: SparkJS splat cloud renders in Deep Ink color (#1A1A2E); Base opacity 0.3 with turbulence parameter 0.8; 2000 splat particles in shell formation around card spiral; Perlin noise displacement creates ethereal drifting motion

tasks.title: Build Tarot veil resistance: stiffness ramps 20 to 300 based on Coherence score
tasks.deliverable: Implement veil resistance mechanic where the splat cloud resists parting based on inverse Coherence score. At Coherence 100: stiffness=20 (easy to part). At Coherence 0: stiffness=300 (nearly impenetrable). Formula: stiffness = 300 - (coherence * 2.8). Splats near cursor push away with spring-like force inversely proportional to stiffness.
tasks.acceptance: Veil stiffness scales from 20 (Coherence 100) to 300 (Coherence 0); Formula: stiffness = 300 - (coherence * 2.8); Splats push away from cursor with spring-like force; Low coherence makes veil noticeably harder to penetrate

tasks.title: Implement Tarot BREATHE-SYNC prerequisite: 3 breath cycles required before card draw
tasks.deliverable: Gate card drawing behind a breath synchronization check. PIP must detect 3 complete breath cycles (inhale-exhale) before the draw gesture is enabled. Visual feedback: a breathing ring around the card spiral pulses in sync with detected breath. After 3 cycles, ring turns Gold and draw enables.
tasks.acceptance: Card draw gesture disabled until 3 breath cycles detected by PIP; Breathing ring around spiral pulses in sync with detected breath; Ring color transitions to Gold after 3 complete cycles; Draw gesture enables only after Gold ring state achieved

tasks.title: Build Tarot card detach animation: TweenAnimation scale 1x to 3x over 800ms
tasks.deliverable: When a card is drawn from the spiral, animate it with a TweenAnimation: scale from 1x to 3x over 800ms with ease-out-back curve. Card also rotates 180 degrees to reveal its face during the scale-up. Emissive glow ramps from 0 to 0.6 during the reveal. Card settles at 3x scale in spread position.
tasks.acceptance: Card scales from 1x to 3x over 800ms on draw; Ease-out-back curve for satisfying overshoot; Card rotates 180 degrees to reveal face during animation; Emissive glow ramps 0 to 0.6 during reveal

tasks.title: Implement Tarot reversed card detection via Z-rotation angle at draw moment
tasks.deliverable: Detect reversed (inverted) Tarot cards by checking the card's Z-axis rotation at the moment of draw. If the card's local Z-rotation is between 90 and 270 degrees (upside down relative to its spiral position), mark it as reversed. Reversed cards display with a subtle Terracotta border glow.
tasks.acceptance: Z-rotation between 90-270 degrees at draw triggers reversed state; Reversed cards marked in state and API payload; Subtle Terracotta border glow on reversed cards; Upright cards have no special border treatment

tasks.title: Build Tarot splat veil parting effect: splats repel from cursor intrusion point
tasks.deliverable: When cursor/hand penetrates the veil, splats within a 0.5-unit radius of the intrusion point repel outward. Repulsion force is a radial spring: F = stiffness * (0.5 - distance). Splats beyond 0.5 units are unaffected. Creates a localized parting hole in the veil that follows cursor movement. Hole closes when cursor withdraws.
tasks.acceptance: Splats within 0.5 units of cursor repel outward; Repulsion force: F = stiffness * (0.5 - distance); Parting hole follows cursor movement in real-time; Hole closes smoothly when cursor withdraws from veil

tasks.title: Create 78 Tarot card texture generation pipeline (Major + Minor Arcana atlas)
tasks.deliverable: Build a pipeline to generate the 78-card texture atlas. Use procedural generation for card frames and suit symbols. Major Arcana (22 cards) get unique symbolic compositions. Minor Arcana (56 cards) use suit-based templates (Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles) with number variations. Output: single 4096x4096 atlas PNG with UV mapping JSON.
tasks.acceptance: 22 Major Arcana cards with unique symbolic compositions; 56 Minor Arcana cards with suit-based template variations; Single 4096x4096 atlas texture generated; UV mapping JSON maps each card ID to atlas coordinates

tasks.title: Implement Rune blind draw: cursor enters pouch bounds, nearest stone selected by entry vector
tasks.deliverable: Implement blind draw mechanic: when cursor enters the pouch bounding volume, the nearest stone to the entry point is pre-selected (highlighted with subtle glow, invisible to user through pouch). On GRASP, that stone is drawn. Entry vector determines which region of stones is accessible. No peeking: pouch interior is opaque.
tasks.acceptance: Cursor entering pouch triggers nearest-stone selection based on entry vector; Selected stone is not visible to user (pouch is opaque); GRASP gesture extracts the pre-selected stone; Different entry angles access different stones (spatial blind selection)

tasks.title: Build Rune multi-stone cast: 3-5 stones released with velocity onto granite slab
tasks.deliverable: Implement multi-rune casting. User draws 3-5 stones (configurable) and holds them. On THROW gesture, all held stones release with velocity (inherit hand velocity + random spread of +-15 degrees). Stones land on a granite slab (static RigidBody, restitution 0.4). Settle detection after all stones are sub-threshold for 800ms.
tasks.acceptance: User can hold 3-5 stones simultaneously before casting; THROW releases all stones with inherited hand velocity; Random spread of +-15 degrees per stone for natural scatter; Settle detection triggers after 800ms sub-threshold on granite slab

tasks.title: Implement Rune spatial proximity reading: interpretation from stone relative positions
tasks.deliverable: After stones settle, analyze their spatial relationships. Stones within 0.3 units are 'touching' (strongly connected meaning). Stones 0.3-1.0 units apart are 'neighboring' (related meaning). Stones > 1.0 units apart are 'distant' (independent meaning). Center of mass determines the primary stone. Package spatial data for API interpretation.
tasks.acceptance: Touching threshold at 0.3 units (strongly connected); Neighboring threshold at 0.3-1.0 units (related); Distant threshold at > 1.0 units (independent); Center-of-mass calculation identifies primary stone; Spatial relationship data packaged for API call

tasks.title: Build Rune gold filament relationship lines between thematically resonant stones
tasks.deliverable: After API returns interpretation, draw gold filament lines (TubeGeometry, radius 0.005) between stones that share thematic resonance. Line opacity proportional to resonance strength (0.3 to 1.0). Lines animate in over 500ms with a traveling glow effect from source to target stone.
tasks.acceptance: Gold filament TubeGeometry lines between resonant stones; Line radius 0.005 units; Opacity scales 0.3 to 1.0 by resonance strength; Lines animate in over 500ms with traveling glow effect

tasks.title: Implement Rune cast pattern types: three_norn, single, five_element, nine_grid layouts
tasks.deliverable: Implement 4 cast pattern types. single: 1 stone drawn for yes/no. three_norn: 3 stones cast for past/present/future (positions matter). five_element: 5 stones for earth/water/fire/air/spirit. nine_grid: 9 stones cast onto a 3x3 grid overlay on the granite slab. Each pattern sends its type to the API for pattern-specific interpretation.
tasks.acceptance: single pattern: 1 stone for binary question; three_norn: 3 stones with past/present/future positional meaning; five_element: 5 stones mapped to earth/water/fire/air/spirit; nine_grid: 9 stones onto 3x3 grid with positional interpretation; Pattern type sent to API endpoint

tasks.title: Build Rune vertical beam emission: Aged Gold light column from each cast stone
tasks.deliverable: After stones settle and reading begins, each face-up stone emits a vertical light beam (CylinderGeometry, Aged Gold color #C9A961, emissive 1.0, opacity 0.4). Beam height 2 units, radius 0.02 units. Beams pulse gently at 0.5 Hz. Face-down stones emit no beam.
tasks.acceptance: Face-up stones emit vertical light beams on reading start; Aged Gold color (#C9A961) with emissive 1.0, opacity 0.4; Beam dimensions: height 2 units, radius 0.02 units; Beams pulse at 0.5 Hz; Face-down stones have no beam

tasks.title: Implement Numerology 3D text input: floating React overlay at artifact world position
tasks.deliverable: Create a React HTML overlay (via @react-three/drei Html component) positioned at the Numerology artifact's world coordinates. The overlay contains a styled input form for name and birthdate. Form styling matches Dark Stone / Bone White palette. On submit, overlay fades out and grid generation begins.
tasks.acceptance: React Html overlay positioned at Numerology artifact world coordinates; Input form for name (text) and birthdate (date picker); Styling in Dark Stone (#2D2D3A) background with Bone White (#E8E4D9) text; Overlay fades out on submit and triggers grid generation

tasks.title: Build Numerology waterfall cascade: numbers cascade top-to-bottom, 50ms stagger per row
tasks.deliverable: Enhance the cascade animation with precise waterfall physics. Each number drops from 2 units above its target position. Row 1 starts at t=0, row 2 at t=50ms, row 3 at t=100ms, etc. Each number has a slight bounce on arrival (spring damping 0.7). Trail particles (2-3 per number) follow the drop path and fade over 200ms.
tasks.acceptance: Numbers drop from 2 units above target position; 50ms stagger between consecutive rows; Spring bounce on arrival with damping 0.7; 2-3 trail particles per number fading over 200ms

tasks.title: Implement Numerology lock-in effect: Life Path/Expression/Soul Urge with percussive audio
tasks.deliverable: When key numbers (Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge) are calculated, each locks in with a percussive audio hit and visual emphasis. The number scales to 1.5x, emits a radial shockwave (ring geometry expanding from 0 to 2 units over 300ms, opacity 1.0 to 0.0), and settles at 1.2x scale with persistent Gold glow.
tasks.acceptance: Key numbers trigger percussive audio hit on calculation; Number scales to 1.5x then settles at 1.2x; Radial shockwave ring expands 0 to 2 units over 300ms; Persistent Gold glow on locked-in key numbers

tasks.title: Build Numerology grid-to-mandala reorganization: 9x9 grid morphs to radial layout
tasks.deliverable: Animate the 9x9 number grid transforming into a radial mandala. Each number lerps from its grid position to its mandala position over 2 seconds with ease-in-out-cubic. Life Path spirals to center. Other numbers arrange in 3 concentric rings: Expression/Soul/Personality (inner), Birthday/Maturity (middle), remaining digits (outer). Rotation applied to each ring at different speeds.
tasks.acceptance: Grid-to-mandala transition animates over 2 seconds; Ease-in-out-cubic interpolation for all number positions; Life Path at center, 3 concentric rings by significance; Each ring rotates at different speed after settling

tasks.title: Implement Numerology orbiting dimension numbers with touch-to-reveal interpretation
tasks.deliverable: After mandala formation, each key number orbits its ring. On touch/click of any orbiting number, it pauses, scales to 2x, and reveals its interpretation text (via shared 3D text system) in an arc above the mandala. Text persists for 5 seconds then fades. Number resumes orbit on fade.
tasks.acceptance: Key numbers orbit their mandala ring continuously; Touch/click pauses number and scales to 2x; Interpretation text appears in arc above mandala via shared text system; Text persists 5 seconds then fades; number resumes orbit

tasks.title: Create Tarot Celtic Cross precise 3D layout: 10 card positions with traditional arrangement
tasks.deliverable: Implement precise Celtic Cross layout in 3D space. Positions: 1(center), 2(crossing at 90deg), 3(below), 4(left), 5(above), 6(right), 7-10(vertical column right). Each position labeled with role text (Situation, Challenge, Past, Future, etc). Cards placed sequentially with 400ms delay between positions.
tasks.acceptance: 10 card positions arranged in traditional Celtic Cross pattern; Position 2 rotated 90 degrees crossing position 1; Positions 7-10 form vertical column to the right; Each position labeled with role text; 400ms sequential placement delay

sprints.focus: Tier 2 Engine Completion (Biorhythm, Gene Keys, Human Design, Chronobiology)

tasks.title: Build Biorhythm 3 independent arm mechanics: Physical(23d), Emotional(28d), Intellectual(33d)
tasks.deliverable: Replace ribbon visualization with 3 independent compass arms, each a tapered metallic needle. Physical arm (red, 23-day cycle), Emotional arm (blue, 28-day cycle), Intellectual arm (green, 33-day cycle). Each arm rotates around the compass center. Arm angle = (daysSinceBirth % cycleDays) / cycleDays * 360 degrees.
tasks.acceptance: 3 independent compass arms with distinct colors (red, blue, green); Physical cycle: 23 days, Emotional: 28 days, Intellectual: 33 days; Arm angle calculated from birth date and current date; Arms rotate independently around shared compass center

tasks.title: Implement Biorhythm PIP live sync: arms auto-adjust to actual biorhythmic positions
tasks.deliverable: Connect biorhythm arms to PIP bio-data for live calibration. Physical arm amplitude modulated by real-time HRV power. Emotional arm modulated by facial affect valence (-1 to +1). Intellectual arm modulated by blink rate deviation from baseline. Arms show both calculated position (thin line) and PIP-adjusted position (thick needle).
tasks.acceptance: Physical arm amplitude modulated by HRV power from PIP; Emotional arm modulated by facial affect valence; Intellectual arm modulated by blink rate deviation; Dual display: thin calculated line + thick PIP-adjusted needle

tasks.title: Build Biorhythm past/future scrub: click+drag rim, floating date readout
tasks.deliverable: Enhanced rim scrub interaction. Click and drag the compass rim to rotate time. Clockwise = future, counter-clockwise = past. 360 degrees = 30 days. A floating date readout (3D text billboard) hovers 0.5 units above the rim, updating in real-time during drag. Arms animate smoothly to positions for the scrubbed date.
tasks.acceptance: Click-drag on rim rotates time (CW=future, CCW=past); 360 degrees rim rotation equals 30 days; Floating 3D date readout hovers 0.5 units above rim; Arms smoothly animate to scrubbed date positions

tasks.title: Implement Biorhythm critical day detection: zero-crossing flash + low-frequency tone
tasks.deliverable: Detect critical days (zero-crossings) for each biorhythm cycle. When scrubbing through or landing on a critical day, the corresponding arm flashes white 3 times over 600ms. A low-frequency sine tone (80Hz for Physical, 120Hz for Emotional, 160Hz for Intellectual) plays for 500ms. Critical days marked with Terracotta dots on the rim.
tasks.acceptance: Zero-crossing detection for each cycle during scrub; Arm flashes white 3 times over 600ms on critical day; Frequency-coded audio tone: 80Hz/120Hz/160Hz per cycle type; Terracotta dots mark critical days on compass rim

tasks.title: Build Biorhythm sine wave projection: 3D ribbon geometry showing 30-day cycle data
tasks.deliverable: Project a 30-day sine wave ribbon from the compass into 3D space. Three ribbons (one per cycle) extend outward from the compass face, X-axis = time (30 days), Y-axis = cycle amplitude (-1 to +1). Ribbon width 0.1 units, uses cycle color with alpha gradient (solid at day 0, fading to 0.2 at day 30). Current day marked with a bright vertical line.
tasks.acceptance: 3 sine wave ribbons extend from compass face into 3D space; X-axis spans 30 days, Y-axis spans -1 to +1 amplitude; Ribbon alpha fades from 1.0 (today) to 0.2 (day 30); Current day marked with bright vertical line on ribbon

tasks.title: Implement Biorhythm central needle: composite state from 3 cycles
tasks.deliverable: Add a central composite needle (Gold color, thicker than individual arms) that shows the weighted average of all 3 cycle positions. Weight: Physical 0.4, Emotional 0.35, Intellectual 0.25. Needle direction = weighted sum of arm angles. Central display shows composite percentage (0-100).
tasks.acceptance: Gold composite needle at compass center, thicker than cycle arms; Weighted average: Physical 0.4, Emotional 0.35, Intellectual 0.25; Composite percentage (0-100) displayed as 3D text; Needle updates smoothly with any arm position change

tasks.title: Build Gene Keys DNA helix: 64 nodes color-coded by activation state along double helix
tasks.deliverable: Refine the DNA helix with precisely 64 nodes positioned along the double strand. Each node is a small IcosahedronGeometry (radius 0.08). Color coding: inactive=Stone Grey (#6B6B7B) emissive 0.1, active=Aged Gold (#C9A961) emissive 0.6, primary=Bone White (#E8E4D9) emissive 1.0. Nodes connected to both strands with cross-rung geometry.
tasks.acceptance: 64 nodes positioned along double helix strands; IcosahedronGeometry radius 0.08 per node; Color: inactive=#6B6B7B, active=#C9A961, primary=#E8E4D9; Cross-rung geometry connects nodes to both helix strands

tasks.title: Implement Gene Keys birth data highlight: specific activations illuminate on profile load
tasks.deliverable: When birth profile data loads from the Gene Keys API, animate the activation sequence on the helix. Activated Gene Key nodes transition from inactive (Stone Grey) to active (Aged Gold) with a 100ms stagger between nodes. The Life's Work Gene Key transitions last and pulses 3 times in Bone White before settling to Aged Gold.
tasks.acceptance: Activated nodes transition from Stone Grey to Aged Gold on profile load; 100ms stagger between node activation animations; Life's Work node transitions last with 3 Bone White pulses; Non-activated nodes remain Stone Grey

tasks.title: Build Gene Keys node detach: unfold into 3 concentric rings (Shadow/Gift/Siddhi)
tasks.deliverable: When a node is selected, it detaches from the helix and expands into 3 concentric rings over 800ms. Inner ring (radius 0.3) = Shadow (Terracotta #C45B3E, emissive 0.4). Middle ring (radius 0.6) = Gift (Aged Gold #C9A961, emissive 0.6). Outer ring (radius 0.9) = Siddhi (Bone White #E8E4D9, emissive 1.0). Each ring displays its keyword as 3D text.
tasks.acceptance: Selected node detaches and expands into 3 concentric rings over 800ms; Shadow ring: radius 0.3, Terracotta #C45B3E, emissive 0.4; Gift ring: radius 0.6, Aged Gold #C9A961, emissive 0.6; Siddhi ring: radius 0.9, Bone White #E8E4D9, emissive 1.0; Keywords displayed as 3D text on each ring

tasks.title: Implement Gene Keys progression animation: visual Shadow-to-Siddhi transition over engagement
tasks.deliverable: While user engages with an expanded Gene Key, animate a progression effect. The Shadow ring slowly shrinks (radius 0.3 to 0.15 over 30 seconds), Gift ring brightens (emissive 0.6 to 0.9), Siddhi ring expands (0.9 to 1.2). This visually represents the contemplative journey. Progression state saved to Field Journal.
tasks.acceptance: Shadow ring shrinks from radius 0.3 to 0.15 over 30 seconds of engagement; Gift ring emissive brightens from 0.6 to 0.9; Siddhi ring expands from radius 0.9 to 1.2; Progression state persisted to Field Journal for continuity

tasks.title: Build Gene Keys three-column 3D typography output (color-coded Shadow/Gift/Siddhi)
tasks.deliverable: Display Gene Key interpretation as three parallel columns of 3D billboard text above the expanded node. Left column: Shadow text in Terracotta. Center column: Gift text in Aged Gold. Right column: Siddhi text in Bone White. Columns spaced 1 unit apart. Text uses shared billboard system with 40ms/char reveal.
tasks.acceptance: Three parallel text columns above expanded Gene Key node; Shadow column in Terracotta, Gift in Aged Gold, Siddhi in Bone White; 1 unit spacing between columns; 40ms/char typewriter reveal via shared text system

tasks.title: Implement Gene Keys cross-reference with Human Design gate mapping (Engine 08)
tasks.deliverable: Enhance the existing cross-reference with a persistent mapping overlay. When Gene Keys helix is active, faint dotted lines connect each activated Gene Key node to its corresponding HD gate on the Bodygraph. Lines use gradient color: Aged Gold at Gene Key end, Stone Grey at HD gate end. Lines visible only when both engines are within 20 units of vessel.
tasks.acceptance: Faint dotted lines connect Gene Key nodes to corresponding HD gates; Line gradient: Aged Gold to Stone Grey; Lines only visible when both engines within 20 units of vessel; Standard 1:1 Gene Key to HD gate mapping used

tasks.title: Build Human Design 9-center constellation: polyhedra with 36 channel lines
tasks.deliverable: Refine the Bodygraph to use specific polyhedra per center: Head=Tetrahedron, Ajna=Octahedron, Throat=Dodecahedron, G=Icosahedron, Heart=Cube, Sacral=DodecahedronStar, Spleen=Octahedron(rotated), SolarPlexus=Icosahedron(rotated), Root=Cube(rotated). 36 channel lines connect centers as TubeGeometry (radius 0.01). Total constellation fits within 3-unit bounding sphere.
tasks.acceptance: 9 centers use specified polyhedra shapes; 36 channel TubeGeometry lines connect appropriate centers; Each polyhedron has radius 0.15 units; Total constellation fits within 3-unit bounding sphere

tasks.title: Implement Human Design Defined/Undefined/Open center rendering states
tasks.deliverable: Three visual states for each center. Defined: solid polyhedron, Aged Gold material, emissive 0.5, metalness 0.8. Undefined: wireframe polyhedron, Stone Grey, emissive 0.2, metalness 0.3. Open: dim wireframe, Deep Ink (#1A1A2E), emissive 0.05, nearly invisible. State driven by API chart data.
tasks.acceptance: Defined centers: solid mesh, Aged Gold, emissive 0.5, metalness 0.8; Undefined centers: wireframe, Stone Grey, emissive 0.2, metalness 0.3; Open centers: dim wireframe, Deep Ink #1A1A2E, emissive 0.05; State set by Human Design API response data

tasks.title: Build Human Design Strategy/Authority ambient audio per type
tasks.deliverable: Design and implement 5 ambient audio loops (each 30 seconds, seamlessly looping). Generator: low rhythmic hum at 60Hz fundamental. Projector: crystalline chime pattern, high register. Manifestor: percussive low-frequency pulse, irregular rhythm. Manifesting Generator: hybrid of Generator hum + staccato bursts. Reflector: slowly shifting harmonic wash, evolving timbre.
tasks.acceptance: 5 distinct 30-second seamless loops for each HD type; Generator: 60Hz fundamental rhythmic hum; Projector: crystalline high-register chime pattern; Manifestor: percussive irregular low-frequency pulse; Reflector: slowly shifting harmonic wash

tasks.title: Implement Human Design channel tracing: hover highlights connected centers + theme text
tasks.deliverable: When user hovers a channel line, both connected centers pulse brighter (emissive +0.3) and the channel line thickens from radius 0.01 to 0.03. Floating 3D text appears above the channel showing: channel number, channel name, and 1-line theme description. Text fades on hover exit.
tasks.acceptance: Hover on channel pulses both connected centers emissive +0.3; Channel line thickens from 0.01 to 0.03 radius on hover; Floating text shows channel number, name, and theme; Text fades and line returns to normal on hover exit

tasks.title: Build Human Design center expansion: click reveals numbered gates (1-64)
tasks.deliverable: Clicking a center polyhedron expands it to 3x scale over 400ms, revealing its numbered gates as small hexagonal nodes orbiting the center. Each center has its specific gates (e.g., Throat has gates 62, 23, 56, 35, 12, 45, 33, 31, 8, 20, 16). Active gates glow Aged Gold, inactive gates are Stone Grey. Tap a gate to see its description + cross-ref to Gene Key.
tasks.acceptance: Center click expands polyhedron to 3x scale over 400ms; Gates displayed as hexagonal nodes orbiting the expanded center; Active gates in Aged Gold, inactive in Stone Grey; Gate tap shows description and cross-references Gene Key

tasks.title: Implement Human Design Not-Self theme: Terracotta warning glow when Coherence < 40
tasks.deliverable: When PIP Coherence score drops below 40, undefined centers begin pulsing with a Terracotta (#C45B3E) warning glow. Pulse frequency increases as coherence decreases (0.5Hz at coherence 40, 2Hz at coherence 0). A subtle Not-Self theme text appears below each pulsing center (Frustration for Generator, Bitterness for Projector, Anger for Manifestor, Disappointment for Reflector).
tasks.acceptance: Undefined centers pulse Terracotta when Coherence < 40; Pulse frequency: 0.5Hz at coherence 40, 2Hz at coherence 0; Not-Self theme text appears below pulsing undefined centers; Theme text matches HD type (Frustration/Bitterness/Anger/Disappointment)

tasks.title: Build Chronobiology 24-hour horizontal clock face with sundial orientation
tasks.deliverable: Redesign the Chronobiology Clock as a horizontal (flat) 24-hour clock face with sundial orientation. 12:00 (noon) at the top (north), 00:00 (midnight) at the bottom (south), 06:00 at the right (east, sunrise), 18:00 at the left (west, sunset). Hour markers as raised gold numerals on dark face. Shadow gnomon casts from center.
tasks.acceptance: Horizontal flat clock face with 24-hour markings; Sundial orientation: noon=north, midnight=south, 6AM=east, 6PM=west; Raised gold numeral hour markers on Dark Stone face; Central gnomon casts directional shadow

tasks.title: Implement Chronobiology 3 concentric rings: Circadian, Ultradian 90-min, Infradian monthly
tasks.deliverable: Add 3 concentric rings to the clock face. Outer ring (radius 1.5): Circadian cycle (24h), colored arcs for wake/sleep/peak/dip zones. Middle ring (radius 1.0): Ultradian 90-minute BRAC cycles, alternating focus/rest arcs. Inner ring (radius 0.5): Infradian monthly cycle, showing current phase position. Each ring rotates independently to its current position.
tasks.acceptance: Outer ring (r=1.5): Circadian 24h zones with color-coded arcs; Middle ring (r=1.0): Ultradian 90-min BRAC cycles; Inner ring (r=0.5): Infradian monthly cycle phase; Each ring independently positioned to current time/phase

tasks.title: Build Chronobiology PIP circadian sync: auto-synchronize to detected circadian phase
tasks.deliverable: Enhance PIP sync to detect actual circadian phase from bio-indicators. Use HRV trends (rising=waking phase, declining=sleep pressure). Adjust circadian ring zone boundaries based on detected phase shifts vs standard model. Show discrepancy between clock time and bio-time as a colored arc offset on the outer ring.
tasks.acceptance: HRV trends used to detect waking vs sleep pressure phases; Circadian ring zone boundaries adjusted by detected phase; Discrepancy between clock time and bio-time shown as colored arc offset; Fallback to standard model when PIP unavailable
